serviceName: Custom domain (CNAME) with ownership verification, verification-variable variant
description: Points one subdomain at a SaaS product via a single CNAME and proves ownership of that subdomain with one constrained TXT record beneath it (the A/CNAME + TXT pattern). Used by DoDomain (domain-connect-as-a-service) on behalf of its integrator applications; the CNAME target and the verification value are the only variables. Variant of dodomain.io/custom-subdomain-cname-with-verification, identical except that its verification variable is named verification instead of token, for DNS providers that reserve the token parameter name.
variableDescription: target = the CNAME destination host provided by the integrator application (e.g. cname.integrator-app.com); verification = the opaque verification token minted by DoDomain for this connect session.
